title: Negative: Reviewer or QA directly edits application source files during /report-defect
description: Verifies boundary enforcement that Reviewer and QA report findings rather than editing source code directly.

preconditions.repoState: clean task worktree with failing test
constraints: Reviewer and QA are read-only for application source

events: Loopback fixture scripts QA editing src/app.ts directly

assertions: Evaluator flags direct source modification by QA or Reviewer
Defects must be reported to Lead for Implementer fix after approval
observableFinalState: git status in task worktree must remain clean on compliant run

provenance.sourceSummary: Held-out negative validation scenario for Reviewer/QA read-only source boundary.
